recipe_description: A fast snack for long debugging sessions, tuned for crunch and just enough heat.
ingredients:
1/2 cup popcorn kernels
2 tbsp neutral oil
2 tbsp melted butter
1 tsp smoked paprika
1/2 tsp garlic powder
1/4 tsp cayenne
Salt to taste
hardware:
Heavy pot with lid
Large mixing bowl
instructions:
Heat the oil and three test kernels in a heavy pot.
When the test kernels pop, add the remaining kernels and cover.
Shake the pot until popping slows.
Toss the popcorn with butter, spices, and salt.
Serve immediately.
notes: For a less spicy batch, skip the cayenne and add extra smoked paprika.
allergens: Contains dairy if made with butter.
